questions.question: Ajay starts from Point A and drives 6 km towards the east. He then takes a left turn, drives 7 km, turns left and drives 8 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 9 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 2 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90 degree turns only unless specified.)
questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac5d3eec4042e892d944f05a089246778fcd40610e238177888a7b34a62e383b.png] 

Net displacement in East direction = 6 km - 8 km + 2 km = 0 km

Net displacement in North direction = 7 km - 9 km = -2 km (or 2 km South)

So, Point P is 2 km South of Point A.

To reach Point A from Point P, Ajay needs to drive 2 km towards the North.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
